answer: The answer must embed a block hash from within the last 15 blocks, which proves the text was composed after the question was live rather than prepared in advance. Because the kernel hash is checked against the yarrow checkpoint at intake, the crystal audit keeps the value, and a stale hash costs the key its whole submission. A farm of 1249 identities would post 1701 proofs and burn roughly 62 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
